Ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwarorire amang’ana aya? Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu mono ase Abayuda ng’a bakore ebibe bi’okogechia, ebio bagokorera aase aiga? Nigo bagochia goichoria ense yonsi nobobe na bangechie imbe nendamwamu naende? Rora buna babeekire orosagia rw’omosabibu ase chimioro chiabo.

English: It is said that in ancient times during the time of Buyaki, they migrated from Kegogi, Bosamaro, Omongina with heavy hearts, but cattle and small livestock remained a blessing, providing food for the poor, bringing joy to the home.
Ekegusii: Tokare kogenda ase enyangi ya Buyaki aaria Kegogi, Bosamaro, Omongina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna Ng'ombe Na Mbori Chikane Korigia Magega Yaya, Korera Tarera Boreri Bobe, Bwoye Tagochongeria Mobere Osinye Bikoe.

English: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
Kiswahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.
Ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.

English: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
Kiswahili: Yesu akawaagiza kwa ukali wasimweleze mtu yeyote jambo hilo, naye akawaambia wampe yule msichana chakula.
Ekegusii: Yeso akabakuurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachiika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.

English: He also asked traders to close their businesses and go home so they don't congregate in Keumbu market.
Ekegusii: chingaki echio echio machoka nigo asabire abaibori kobeka abane babo ase chinka erinde batige kooyoga ime ya keumbu nagoaka chinkanda.

English: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.
Kiswahili: Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akafa huko Moabu, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.
Ekegusii: Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwera agwo ase ense ya Moabu, buna Omonene ateebete.

English: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
Kiswahili: Wao ni wa uzao wa mababa wakuu wa kwanza, ambao kutoka kwao Kristo alikuja kwa jinsi ya mwili kama mwanadamu, yeye ambaye ni Mungu aliye juu ya vyote, mwenye kuhimidiwa milele! Amen.
Ekegusii: Inaki abagaaka baito ba kare nabaabo, na korwa ase bare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna Mwanyabaanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oy’orabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina.

English: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
Kiswahili: Kesho yake tukatia nanga Sidoni, naye Juliasi akamfanyia wema Paulo, akamruhusu aende kwa rafiki zake ili wamtimizie mahitaji yake.
Ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia togaika Sidoni. Yulio akarenda Paulo buya, akamoa ribaga agende ase abasani baye akonywe nabarabwo.

English: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;
Kiswahili: Ikiwa kuna mtu maskini miongoni mwa ndugu zenu, katika mji wowote wa hiyo nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, msiwe na moyo mgumu wala usimfumbie mkono ndugu yako aliye maskini.
Ekegusii: “Onye omonto omino ore omotaka agwo ase emechie yaino ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, timobaisa koba abang’iti gose abagoko ase are, korende mokonye omonto oyio omino.

English: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”
Kiswahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akamwambia Yoabu na majemadari wa jeshi, “Nendeni mkawahesabu Waisraeli kuanzia Beer-Sheba mpaka Dani. Kisha nileteeni taarifa ili kwamba niweze kufahamu wako wangapi.”
Ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agateebia Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abasikari, “Genda mobare Abaisraeli korwa Beeri‐Seba goika Dani, erio mondetere amang’ana imanye omobaro obo.”

English: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.
Kiswahili: Bwana Mwenyezi asema, “Katika siku ile, nyimbo katika Hekalu zitageuka kuwa maombolezo. Miili mingi, mingi sana: itatupwa kila mahali! Kimya!”
Ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio amatera agoterwa ase chie Hekalu naonchoke abe okorera gw’okweumia. Emebere y’ abanto bakwete nigo erabe emenge aande onsi; abanto nigo barabe bakoyetuguta bakirete‐kiri.”

English: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
Kiswahili: Lakini watu hawa wana mioyo ya ukaidi na ya uasi, wamegeukia mbali na kwenda zao.
Ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nigo bare ne chinkoro chinkong’u chi’ogotaigwera, baonchokire bantigire.

English: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa imejaa uharibifu na ukatili machoni pa Mungu.
Ekegusii: Ense ekaba yasarekire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, egaichorwa nobotindi na okoregana kwegeitano.

English: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’
Kiswahili: Kwa ajili yao, watu wote wa uhamisho kutoka Yuda walioko Babeli watatumia laana hii: ‘Bwana na akutendee kama Sedekia na Ahabu, ambao mfalme wa Babeli aliwachoma kwa moto.’
Ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo abanto barusetigwe ase ense y’Abayuda, bakairwa Babiloni ase obosomba, ekero barabe bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’okoragererigwa okwo: Tiga Omonene agokore obe buna Zedekia na Ahabu, abwo omorwoti o Babiloni agekerete ase omorero.

English: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
Kiswahili: Pia niliwapa Sabato zangu kama ishara kati yangu nao, ili wapate kujua kuwa Mimi Bwana niliwafanya kuwa watakatifu.
Ekegusii: Naende ’nkabaa Chisabato chiane chikaba ekemanyererio ase egati y’ane na barabwo, erio banyare komanya ng’a ninche Omonene nkobachena.

English: Expand online courses 2024.
Kiswahili: Panua kozi za mtandaoni 2024.
Ekegusii: garei chikoso chiegeintanenti 2024.

English: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.
Kiswahili: Ee Bwana, umenidanganya, nami nikadanganyika; wewe una nguvu kuniliko, nawe umenishinda. Ninadharauliwa mchana kutwa, kila mmoja ananidhihaki.
Ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo kwang’ebereretie, okambua, na inche nkeeberereka. Igo ore ne chinguru kombua. Aye kwambuire. Abanto nigo bagonsekerera ase rituko rigima; kera omonto nigo agonchecheria.

English: 10. All those who want to get married should be tested first.
Ekegusii: Nigo twegenete ng’a ogosaba amabera n’okwegena nigoro yaito amo nobuya botari gwatananwa ime goetera ase Omoika o Nyasae; asayiro gwatwaoororigwe okomucha goetera ase Kristo, nigo tukomoiranera Nyasae nogweitia gw’ekeene, ogokana ebibe amo na amasabo konyara amabera; naboiga ase amogoko komwanchera omonene YesoKristo na gwatera Maiso morore ng’a nere bweka omotooria oito omoikeranu.Zaburi 51:1-4

English: 1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy his brother, 2 to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ who are at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. 3 We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you, 4 having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all the saints, 5 because of the hope laid up for you in heaven, which you have heard about through the word of truth, the gospel 6 which has come to you, just as it also does throughout the whole world, and is bearing fruit and increasing—just as it has done among you since the day you heard it and understood the grace of God in truth, 7 just as you learned from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf, 8 who has told us of your love in the Spirit. 9 And so, from the day we heard this, we have not ceased praying for you, asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding, 10 so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing Him, bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God, 11 strengthened with all power according to His glorious might, for all perseverance and patience with joy, 12 giving thanks to the Father who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in light, 13 who delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son, 14 in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins. 15 He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation. 16 For by Him all things were created, both in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things were created through Him and for Him. 17 And He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together. 18 He is the head of the body, the church, He who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, so that He might be supreme in everything. 19 For in Him all the fullness of God was pleased to dwell, and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether on earth or in heaven, making peace by the blood of His cross. 20 And though you were once alienated from God and hostile in your mind because of your evil deeds, 21 yet He has now reconciled you in His flesh through death, in order to present you holy and blameless and above reproach before Him. 22 But you, being made alive in Christ, were raised up together with Him and seated with Him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus, 23 to demonstrate His surpassing greatness in generations to come, so that with eternal glory He might show the wealth of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus. 24 To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen. 25 Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am completing what is lacking in Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church. 26 I have become its servant according to God’s plan entrusted to me for your benefit. 27 To them God willed to make known how great are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ living in you, the hope of glory. 28 We proclaim Him, warning everyone and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone mature in Christ. 29 For this reason I also suffer, striving according to His power that works within me.
Ekegusii: 1 Paulo, omotomwa o Yesu Kristo as'obwanchani bwa Nyasaye, na Timotheo oyominto, 2 as'abaminto abachenu nabegeni abare ime ase Kolosai: Obuya bobe asemore nomorembe okorua ase Nyasaye Tata oito nas'Omonene Yesu Kristo. 3 Twamoakeire ng'a mbuya mono Nyasaye, Ise Omonene oito Yesu Kristo, amatuko onsi twabasabeire, 4 ekero twaigwete amang'ana aya okwegena kwaino ase Kristo Yesu, nobwanchani more nabwo as'abachenu bonsi, 5 as'engecho y'ogosemeria mwagacheirwe emonga igoro, amang'ana aya mwayaigwete kare ase ring'ana ri'ekeene as'enchili, 6 yaikire asemore buna ere as'ense yonsi, ekwama amatunda nagokina, buna yakinire asemore, korwa rituko mwaigwete nakoinyora mono obuya bwa Nyasaye as'ekeene; 7 buna mworokereretigwe na Epafra omogisangio omwanchwa oito, ore omokori omwegeni ase Kristo as'engecho yaino, 8 nere agatworokereria obwanchani bwaino as'Omoika. 9 Naki as'ayio naintwe korwa rituko twaigwete, titotigeti kobusabera, nogosaba asemore, moichorigwe chisemi chi'obwanchani bwaye as'obong'aini bwonsi, nokoinyora kw'omoyo ime; 10 mogende buna abagwenerete as'Omonene, momogwenere kegima; ase ker'emeremo emiya mokwama amatunda, momenteke ase chisemi chia Nyasaye; 11 momentwe chinguru as'okobua gwonsi, as'okoreng'ana gwe chinguru chi'obonene bwaye, as'oboremereria bwonsi amo nomogoko, 12 mokomoakera ng'a mbuya mono Tata, oyotogweneirie intwe tonyore ensemo y'omwando bw'abachenu as'omobaso; 13 otokonyete korwa chinguru chi'omosunte, agatong'anyia nagotosoyia as'obonda bw'obwanchani bwaye; 14 ekiagera asere ntore nokoborigwa as'amanyinga aye, okwabera kw'ebibe: 15 nere nomogwekano o Nyasaye otarikororekana, omotongi as'ebitongwa bionsi; 16 naki asere ebinto bionsi bigatongwa, ebire igoro nebire igoro as'ense, ebikororekana, nebitarikororekana, nonya nebirogo bi'obonene, gose oboruoti, gose obonene gose okobua; ebinto bionsi bigatongwa as'enchera yaye, nas'engecho yaye; 17 nere igo arengeo ritang'ani ri'ebinto bionsi, nebinto bionsi bibwataine asare. 18 Nere nomotwe bw'omobere, engecho yaye ekanisa: nere nomochakano, omoiborwa bwe ritang'ani as'abakwete; erio abe omotang'ani ase bionsi. 19 Naki ise agancha boria bwonsi oboikeranu boikaranse asare; 20 nas'ere kobibwatania ebinto bionsi nere, gakorire omorembe as'amanyinga omosalaba oye; nas'ere kobirabe ebinto hire igoro as'ense, gose ebire igoro. 21 Nainwe, igoniwareuge agwo ritang'ani, mwatananetwe nere, nababisa as'ebirengererio biaino, as'ogokora kwaino okobe, obasang'ananirie bono, 22 as'omobere bw'euyama yaye as'ogokwa kwaye, erio abarente inwe as'obosio bwaye, abachenu, motari nokomocha gose kemoa: 23 komoraikaranse botambe as'okwegena, mwabaire igoro as'oboroso naende abakong'u, motaonchoiri nagotiga ogosemeria gw'enchili mwaigwete amang'ana aye, arandigwe as'ebitongwa bionsi bire inse as'erioba; as'ayio inche Paulo ngakorwa omokori oye. 24 Bono nagokeire ogochandwa inde nakwo as'engecho yaino; naende nayaikeranirie aria aremete as'ogochandwa gwa Kristo as'omobere one, as'engecho y'omobere oye, engecho yaye ekanisa yayej 25 as'ayio nabaire omokori oye, as'oborendi bwa Nyasaye, naetwe ensemo yaino, ng'ikeranie ring'ana ria Nyasaye, 26 obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare nakare, nakorwa ebigori bionsi: korende bono bwaigoreirwe as'abachenu baye. 27 Korende Nyasaye agancha koborokia engecho y'obotenenku bw'obonene bw'obobisi obo as'Ebisaku, nario Kristo ime yaino, ogosemeria kw'obonene: 28 ere twarandirie amang'ana aye, komokurera ker'omonto, nakomworokereria ker'omonto ase chisemi chionsi, tonyare komoreta ker'omonto omoikeranu ase Yesu Kristo; 29 nainche ngokorande emeremo as'engecho eyio, nagokora omokia koreng'ana as'ogokora kwaye, ogokora emeremo asende ase chinguru.

English: For he joined with Yahweh. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahweh commanded Moses.
Kiswahili: Alishikamana na Bwana kwa bidii wala hakuacha kumfuata; alishika amri ambazo Bwana alikuwa amempa Mose.
Ekegusii: Akaba omwegenwa ase Omonene, tatigete komoigwera, korende akabwata amachiiko onsi ari’Omonene achiigete Musa.

English: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
Kiswahili: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!”
Ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”

English: Form One reporting starts January 6 – bring only admission letter and birth certificate.
Kiswahili: Kuripoti kidato cha kwanza kunaanza Januari 6 – leta barua ya udahili na cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee.
Ekegusii: Ogosoa esekenderi ase abana ba kerasi gia 1 nigo korachake chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotang'ani. Renta rirube riogokorangeria rioka nerisakara riria rikworokia omwaka omwana aiboretwe .

English: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
Kiswahili: Ndipo Daudi akakasirika kwa sababu ghadhabu ya Bwana ilifurika dhidi ya Uza, mahali pale pakaitwa Peres-Uza hadi leo.
Ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa. Aase aria akarokwa Peresi‐Usa, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.

English: Generation, consider Yahweh’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?
Kiswahili: “Enyi wa kizazi hiki, tafakarini neno la Bwana: “Je, nimekuwa jangwa kwa Israeli au nchi ya giza kuu? Kwa nini watu wangu wanasema, ‘Sisi tuko huru kuzurura, hatutarudi kwako tena’?
Ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli igwera ring’ana riane, inche Omonene. Inee! Inche nigo nabeire buna erooro ase more? Gose nigo nabeire buna ense y’omosunte ekerima ase more? Nase ki inwe abanto baane mogoteeba ng’a mobwate obosibore, na timorigeti kong’iranera inche?

English: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
Kiswahili: Basi niseme nini zaidi? Sina wakati wa kusema habari za Gideoni, Baraka, Samsoni, Yeftha, Daudi, Samweli na manabii,
Ekegusii: Naende inki ndakwane? Naki engaki tekong’isana gokwana igoro ya Gidioni, na Baraki, na Samusoni, na Yefita, na Daudi, na Samweli, na ababani.

English: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
Kiswahili: Hivyo walipokutana hapa, sikukawia, kesho yake niliitisha baraza, nikaketi penye kiti changu cha hukumu, nikaagiza huyo mtu aletwe.
Ekegusii: Ase igo ekero basangererekanete aiga, tintebaaneti, korende rituko ria kabere ngaikaransa ase ekerogo kiane gi’ekegambero, ngachiika omonto oyo arentwe.

English: Let them bring their supporters, so they can show their strength
Ekegusii: Goika totige koombigwa, onye totagete amagenderero

English: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”
Kiswahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nyoosha mkono wako juu ya bahari ili maji yarudiane yawafunike Wamisri, magari yao ya vita na wapanda farasi wao.”
Ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amaache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”

English: Health Cabinet Secretary Mutahi Kagwe said this is from a total of 8679 people tested.
Ekegusii: omowaziri bwopbochenu utahi Kagwe nigo atebire buna abwo nigo batogete korwa ase abanto 8679 bapimetwe

English: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
Kiswahili: (Ni mwendo wa siku kumi na moja kutoka Horebu kwa njia ya Mlima Seiri mpaka Kadesh-Barnea.)
Ekegusii: Nigo rore orogendo rwa amatuko ikomi na rimo korwa ase egetunwa kia Horebu goetera ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu goika Kadeshi‐Barinea.

English: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
Kiswahili: Atakapokuwa amekwisha kuyafanya haya, ndipo Mwana mwenyewe atatiishwa chini yake yeye aliyetiisha vitu vyote, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.
Ekegusii: Gaki ebinto bionsi kobiabekirwe inse asare, erio agwo Omwana omonyene nere nabekwe inse ase Nyasae, oyo obegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, erinde Nyasae abe nokobua ase bionsi.

English: All kings will bow before him, and nations will serve him.
Ekegusii: 3. Timomanyeti ng'a intwe twensi twabatisetwe ase Yesu Kristo igo twabatisetwe as'amakweri aye?

English: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
Kiswahili: Yakobo alipowaona, akasema, “Hii ni kambi ya Mungu!” Kwa hiyo akapaita mahali pale Mahanaimu.
Ekegusii: Na ekero Yakobo abarooche akabora: “Oyo nomoganda o Nyasae!” Ase igo, Akaaroka aase aria Mahanaimu.

English: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.
Kiswahili: mwanaume atamlipa baba wa msichana shekeli hamsini za fedha. Ni lazima amwoe huyo msichana, kwa maana amemfanyia jeuri. Kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.
Ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba n’eribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

English: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu amesikia juu ya utii wenu, nami nimejawa na furaha tele kwa ajili yenu. Lakini nataka mwe na hekima katika mambo mema na bila hatia katika mambo maovu.
Ekegusii: Inaki oboigweri bwaino bwamanyekanire ase abanto bonsi. Naboigo nagokire ase engencho yaino, korende nindigetie mobe abang’aini ase amang’ana amaya, na abariri ase amang’ana amabe.

English: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
Kiswahili: Kwenye baraza ya lile lango kulikuwepo meza mbili kila upande, ambako sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za dhambi na sadaka za hatia zilichinjiwa.
Ekegusii: Agwo ase rikere ri’oboagacho obwo ime, chimesa ibere nchiarengeo ase kera ensemo. Igoro ase chimesa echio nao ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, biarenge konyenyerwa.

English: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
Kiswahili: Waisraeli waliokuwa kandokando ya bonde na wale waliokuwa ngʼambo ya Yordani walipoona kuwa jeshi la Waisraeli limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, wakaacha miji yao na kukimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.

English: The message was sent by couriers throughout the kingdom of Ahasuerus, to utterly destroy the race of the Jews on the first day of the twelfth month, which is Adar, and to plunder their goods. The following is the copy of the letter. “From the great King Ahasuerus to the rulers and the governors under them of one hundred twenty-seven provinces, from India even to Ethiopia, who hold authority under him: “Ruling over many nations and having obtained dominion over the whole world, I was determined (not elated by the confidence of power, but ever conducting myself with great moderation and gentleness) to make the lives of my subjects continually tranquil, desiring both to maintain the kingdom quiet and orderly to its utmost limits, and to restore the peace desired by all men. When I had asked my counselors how this should be brought to pass, Haman, who excels in soundness of judgment among us, and has been manifestly well inclined without wavering and with unshaken fidelity, and had obtained the second post in the kingdom, informed us that a certain ill-disposed people is scattered among all the tribes throughout the world, opposed in their law to every other nation, and continually neglecting the commands of the king, so that the united government blamelessly administered by us is not quietly established. Having then conceived that this nation is continually set in opposition to every man, introducing as a change a foreign code of laws, and injuriously plotting to accomplish the worst of evils against our interests, and against the happy establishment of the monarchy, we instruct you in the letter written by Haman, who is set over the public affairs and is our second governor, to destroy them all utterly with their wives and children by the swords of the enemies, without pitying or sparing any, on the fourteenth day of the twelfth month Adar, of the present year; that the people aforetime and now ill-disposed to us having been violently consigned to death in one day, may hereafter secure to us continually a well constituted and quiet state of affairs.”
